segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין אָדָם נִכְנָס לָעֲזָרָה לַעֲבוֹדָה אֲפִילּוּ טָהוֹר עַד שֶׁיִּטְבּוֹל. חָמֵשׁ טְבִילוֹת וַעֲשָׂרָה קִדּוּשִׁין טוֹבֵל כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל וּמְקַדֵּשׁ בּוֹ בַּיּוֹם, וְכוּלָּן בַּקֹּדֶשׁ עַל בֵּית הַפַּרְוָה, חוּץ מִזּוֹ בִּלְבַד. פֵּרְסוּ סָדִין שֶׁל בּוּץ בֵּינוֹ לְבֵין הָעָם (קִידֵּשׁ יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו).
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A person does not enter the» Temple «courtyard for the» Temple «service, even» if he is «pure, until he immerses. Five immersions and ten sanctifications» the «High Priest immerses and sanctifies» his hands and feet, respectively, «on the day» of Yom Kippur. «And all» of these immersions and sanctifications take place «in the sacred» area, the Temple courtyard, «on» the roof of the «Hall of Parva, except for this» first immersion «alone.» As that immersion is not unique to Yom Kippur, it may be performed outside the courtyard. «They spread a sheet of fine linen between him and the people» in the interest of modesty, and then the High Priest immersed and «sanctified his hands and feet.»

moves.summary: even a pure person must immerse before entering for service
five immersions and ten sanctifications, all in the sacred area except the first
a linen sheet was spread between him and the people

positions.claim: no one enters the courtyard for service without immersing; the High Priest performs five immersions and ten sanctifications, all in the sacred area except the first
